spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-16 for main sections to let elements breathe.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none for maximum tactical, brutalist aesthetic. Avoid rounded corners completely to portray elite precision.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use rigid bento grids for Services. Overlapping asymmetry for the 'Philosophy' section.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text blocks for clarity, use bold typography for visual weight.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium momentum feel. Install and implement.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up animations (Framer Motion) on text and images (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and interactive cards translate -translate-y-1 on hover. No soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat color. Primary: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-[#F0545F] uppercase font-bold tracking-widest. Secondary: border border-[#E63946] text-[#E63946] hover:bg-[#E63946] hover:text-white uppercase font-bold tracking-widest.
components.cards: bg-[#242424] border border-white/10 p-6 md:p-8. High contrast, technical look.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Custom style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus:border-[#E63946] focus:ring-0. Minimalist tactical input.
components.badges: bg-[#E63946]/10 text-[#E63946] border border-[#E63946]/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs uppercase font-bold tracking-widest

instructions_to_main_agent: Assign font-family for tailwind classes in tailwind.config.js: font-heading: 'Anton', font-subheading: 'Oswald', font-body: 'DM Sans'.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for a sharp, tactical look. Avoid generic rounded icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-submit').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping marketing layouts; only use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, and standard UI elements.
Background must be exactly #1A1A1A everywhere. Do not use generic Tailwind slate or gray.
For the Hero background image, apply an overlay of bg-black/60 to ensure the pure white text is perfectly legible and meets APCA standards.
Implement a sticky navigation bar with a glassmorphic dark effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1A1A1A]/70) and a sharp 1px bottom border (border-white/10).
For the Pricing Section: The middle tier should have a prominent #E63946 border, a 'Most Popular' badge, and slightly scale up (scale-105 on desktop) to establish hierarchy.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions; use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove all border-radius (rounded-none).
